t: Stateless Minds: How AI's Architecture Shapes Our Future and Google's Dominance
s: This article posits that modern AI, from bioelectric fields to LLMs, demystifies intelligence, eroding human uniqueness. It argues that Google's dominance in AI stems from its vertical integration of research, Transformer architecture, and proprietary TPU infrastructure, while LLMs' stateless architecture inherently provides a 'Physics of Safety' against Skynet scenarios.
sub: Demystification of Intelligence & Erosion of Human Uniqueness ('Move 37')
AI Winter thaw, Deep Learning, and Transformer architecture ('Attention Is All You Need')
Google's vertical integration: DeepMind, Brain, TPUs, and datacenter infrastructure
Statelessness of LLMs as 'Physics of Safety' and the Golem analogy
The Semmelweis Reflex regarding consciousness and AI 'qualia'
